device.description: octal 12-bit voltage-output DAC with internal reference, TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), LDAC, preset and DOUT daisy-chain output

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A holding register (A3-A0 = 0, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B holding register (A3-A0 = 1, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C holding register (A3-A0 = 2, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D holding register (A3-A0 = 3, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: INE
registers.note: DAC E holding register (A3-A0 = 4, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: INF
registers.note: DAC F holding register (A3-A0 = 5, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: ING
registers.note: DAC G holding register (A3-A0 = 6, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: INH
registers.note: DAC H holding register (A3-A0 = 7, register map p.11); power-on zero (p.10)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACE
registers.note: DAC E latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACF
registers.note: DAC F latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACG
registers.note: DAC G latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: DACH
registers.note: DAC H latch; loaded from the holding register while LDAC is low (p.10)

registers.name: CTRL0
registers.note: A3-A0 = 1000: PD full power down, DO DOUT enable, R1:R0 reference (0/1 external, 2 internal 1 V, 3 internal 2 V), IM input mode (0 straight, 1 twos complement); D11-D5 reserved; default 0 (p.12)

registers.name: CTRL1
registers.note: A3-A0 = 1001: PXY power down DAC pair XY, SXY fast settling of pair XY; D11-D8 reserved; default 0 (p.12)

registers.name: PRESET
registers.note: A3-A0 = 1010: preset value loaded to the outputs by PRE low with LDAC asserted; cleared by POR (p.12)

commands.name: Write DAC
commands.note: A3-A0 0-7 = DAC A-H holding register; 12-15 = two-channel registers DAC A and B ... G and H (register map p.11); TLV5630 decodes all 12 data bits (p.12)

protocol.note: uC mode (MODE high): FS low frames the 16-bit word, data sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK low at FS falling, Figure 11 -> mode 1); FS high before the 16th falling edge cancels the transfer; the DAC holding register is written after the rising edge of FS (p.10-11)

ldac.note: DAC outputs are only updated while LDAC is low; asynchronous (p.2, p.10)

notModeled: analog: voltage outputs, REF input/output and the internal reference (CTRL0.R stored only), settling speed (CTRL1 SXY) and pair/full power down effects (CTRL1 PXY, CTRL0 PD), twos-complement input mode (CTRL0.IM: the code is stored as written)
DSP mode (MODE open or low: FS only a short low pulse, an extra SCLK falling edge before FS) is not modeled; uC mode (MODE high) is
two-channel registers (A3-A0 = 1100-1111) write the value to one DAC of the pair and its complement to the other (p.12); the model writes the same value to both
PRE pin: driving PRE low with LDAC asserted loads the PRESET register value into the DAC outputs (p.12); not modeled (PRE is an unused input)
DOUT daisy-chain output (DIN delayed 16 SCLK cycles while CTRL0.DO = 1, p.10, p.12) is not modeled: DOUT is never driven
power on: the datasheet sets the DAC outputs to zero only if LDAC is low (p.10); the model resets all latches to zero
variants: tlv5630.pdf covers TLV5630 (12-bit), TLV5631 (10-bit, decodes D11-D2) and TLV5632 (8-bit, decodes D11-D4): same pinout and register map; one spec file each. TLV5608/TLV5610/TLV5629 are the same register map without the internal reference (CTRL0 R1:R0 reserved there).
